name: rachnasutra
description: RachnaSutra AI: open-source UI/UX design, accessibility and responsive audit agent skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot and Gemini CLI, plus an evidence-first, keyless CLI.
author: Vatsal Shah

scripts.verify: npm run build && node dist/cli.js verify
scripts.samples: npm run build && node dist/cli.js audit fixtures/intentionally-broken-ui --format json,md,html,sarif --out samples/broken-ui && node dist/cli.js audit fixtures/good-ui --format json,md,html --out samples/good-ui && node scripts/sanitize-paths.mjs samples
